description: The recording overlay is a standalone canvas page with no bundler and no @tauri-apps/api import, so it reads events off the global Tauri bridge. It gets exactly one permission, core:event:default, so it can subscribe to audio-amplitude and render a real level meter. Before this it drew bars from a sine of time, which animated identically whether the mic heard your voice or silence, and that is part of why a 35 dB capture bug stayed invisible for so long. It still calls nothing, so it needs nothing else.
